newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's JSE says CDC listing under threat.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's JSE says CDC listing under threat.

text.p: South Africa's Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) said on Friday Consolidated Diamond Corporation's (CDC) listing was under threat of suspension as it had not submitted its annual financial statements in line with JSE rules.
The exchange said the company had not submitted its financial statements within six months of its year-end.
It had until the end of January to publish its financial statements failing which its listing would be automatically suspended, the JSE said.
